body_html:
Watch out @scsu students data fetishization of #HigherEd coming to you. Soon you will have to take high stakes test in LEP classes to appease outside forces unrelated to your learning:

"We are headed into university wide re-accreditation.

Every LEP course MUST have an assessment plan in place for fall, and then discussed in department to document how we are meeting the LEP objectives and adjusting instruction accordingly. "
